en: A vintage black‑and‑white postcard view of a wide, elegant city street lined with multi‑story European‑style buildings. Horse‑drawn carriages and pedestrians move along the street, which is bordered by iron railings and balconies. The scene appears early 20th‑century. Printed caption text at the bottom identifies the location and street name, and a website watermark is overlaid on the lower right.
